rules.readme:
# Project rules

One Markdown file per rule, in a folder per category (`<category>/<ID>-<slug>.md`). Create them with `rules.py add`, list the rules for an app and a skill with `rules.py list --app <app> --skill <skill>`. Format and commands: the kit's `docs/rules.md`.
